released
statistics regarding the success of GTA VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, 2026. According to the corporation, no other game has had such an outstanding launch on its consoles.
GTA VI
The key number is 39 million. That’s how many unique PlayStation users have experienced GTA VI within the first four days of its release, according to Sony’s data.
Sony also boasted that GTA VI set a record for peak online players among all games ever released on PlayStation. It managed to attract more simultaneous players than even free-to-play multiplayer hits like Fortnite. Sony did not disclose the exact number, so it remains a topic of speculation.
In total, PlayStation 5 owners played GTA VI for approximately 683 million hours over four days. On average, each player spent 17.4 hours in the game.
Additionally, Sony noted that the release of GTA VI significantly boosted the PlayStation 5 audience. The corporation calculated that more new PlayStation 5 consoles connected to its network within a day because of the game than on any other day since the console’s launch in 2020—excluding the holiday season. Furthermore, GTA VI was the first title launched by 70% of new PlayStation 5 owners.
The release of GTA VI occurred on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series. Microsoft has yet to share its own figures regarding the new release.
